UK country outline adapted from Natural Earth110m admin0 countries (United Kingdom geometry only), accessed23October2026. Public domain. Source: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Projection: simple equirectangular teaching locator, lon→x and lat→y; generalised outline, not a survey map. Rock-site markers and geological interpretation are original selected teaching examples, not Natural Earth geology data or actual mapped boundaries.
